Name: SBV - Twilight Feathers Wallet Currency
Author: Allifreyr
Description:
A simple quality-of-life mod that makes the Twilight Feathers from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url] a wallet currency. Free up your inventory and stop worrying about leaving your feathers behind in a chest! Any feathers you pick up will be automatically added to your wallet


I personally loved using a similar mod([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26230?tab=description]VMV - Vapius Coins Wallet Currency[/url])﻿ for Vapius Coins from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/url] and wanted the same convenience for Twilight Feathers. Since a version for them didn't exist yet, I decided to share mine with the community!
